insurer_name: Star Health and Allied Insurance Co. Ltd.
sub_limits_waiting_notes: Assisted Reproduction Treatment: 36 months waiting period.

inpatient_hospitalization.notes: Room rent: Single Private A/C Room. Includes ICU, surgeon fees, anaesthetist, diagnostics, dialysis, chemo/radiotherapy, pacemaker/stent.

day_care_treatments.limit_text: All day-care procedures up to Sum Insured

domiciliary_treatment.notes: For treatment exceeding 3 days when hospitalization is not possible. Excludes listed conditions (asthma, bronchitis, hypertension, diabetes, etc.).

ayush_coverage.limit_text: Up to Sum Insured (Ayurveda, Unani, Siddha, Homeopathy in AYUSH Hospital)
ayush_coverage.notes: Yoga and Naturopathy claims need prior approval.

newborn_coverage.limit_text: 10% of Sum Insured or Rs 50,000 whichever is less
newborn_coverage.notes: From 16th day after birth, requires mother continuously insured 12 months without break.

organ_donor_expenses.limit_text: 10% of Sum Insured or Rs 1 lakh whichever is less
organ_donor_expenses.notes: Inpatient hospitalization expenses for donor; transplantation claim must be payable.

ambulance_cover.limit_text: Road ambulance: Rs 750 per hospitalization, Rs 1,500 per policy period. Air ambulance: up to 10% of SI per policy year (SI Rs 5L+).

restoration_benefit.limit_text: Automatic Restoration: 3 times in a Policy Year by 100% each. Recharge Benefit: additional indemnity once for remaining policy period.
restoration_benefit.notes: Restored SI usable only for unrelated illness. Recharge can be used for same hospitalization. Not available for Modern Treatment.

preventive_health_checkup.limit_text: Network provider check-up; Package A (SI Rs 5-10L) or Package B (SI Rs 15-25L)

copayment_trigger_notes: 20% co-payment applies if entry age is 61 years and above (fresh & renewal). Voluntary co-pay options 10%/20% with premium discount.

disease_wise_sub_limits.cataract: Up to Rs 40,000-50,000 per eye; Rs 60,000-75,000 per policy period (varies by SI)

permanent_exclusions: Treatment for alcoholism, drug or substance abuse
notable_exclusions_summary: Cosmetic surgery, gender change, substance abuse, self-injury, unproven treatments and non-medically-necessary admissions are excluded. Diagnostic-only admissions not covered.
claim_process_summary: Cashless at 14,000+ network hospitals (97% claims approved in under 3 hours). Customer service 044-6900 6900.
